reason: @hawiyah/angular renders the skeleton on its host element hw-skeleton, which carries the class hw-skeleton; the vanilla markup, React and Vue render span.hw-skeleton.
reference: @hawiyah/angular README.md: "The host is the skeleton (`hw-skeleton.hw-skeleton[aria-hidden=true]`, no inner element): size it with `style` or `class` on the element, `<hw-skeleton style="inline-size: 60%; block-size: 2rem" />`; the default is a full-width block of 1rem."
